incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A quiet, dimly lit street at night with a row of traditional brick buildings featuring white-framed windows and external lighting.

observations.description: A row of multi-story brick buildings with white-framed windows, lit by exterior wall-mounted lamps.
Red flowering plants in window boxes on the upper floors of the buildings.
A paved street with a curb in front of the buildings.
